snippet.title: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days - 1.0 Hard Launch Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days will officially leave Early Access and launch its full 1.0 release in March 2027, bringing its gripping survival experience to players across Steam, the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and GeForce NOW.

Buy now in Early Access on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2239710/Into_the_Dead_Our_Darkest_Days/

Wishlist now on Playstation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019490

Wishlist now on Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/into-the-dead-our-darkest-days-e09172

Wishlist now on Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/into-the-dead-our-darkest-days/9plv1h5tw8gq

Press inquiries: pikpok@deadgoodmedia.com 

______

Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days is a side-scrolling shelter survival game that transports players to Texas, 1980 at the height of summer during the outbreak of a deadly apocalypse. Lead a group of desperate survivors from shelter to shelter as they attempt to escape Walton City before it is overrun. Scavenge, craft, fight, and plan your next move — and try not to lose yourself along the way.

Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days is the latest instalment in the highly successful franchise from New Zealand publisher and developer PikPok.

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/intothedead
